claim_text: Through our recycling and reuse initiatives, we were able to meet 39% of our overall demand, while water extraction at KGP remained well below the licensed annual entitlement.
metric_name: Total water use; Reused water; Recycled water; withdrawn water
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The report states that recycling and reuse initiatives met 39% of overall water demand, while the disclosed KGP total withdrawn water of 3,563 ML remained below the approved annual entitlement of 5,000 ML.
